title.zh: 将拉古纳省 Sta. Cruz 拉古纳中学的名称变更为Pedro Guevara 纪念中学的法案
title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Laguna High School in Sta. Cruz, Province of Laguna, to Pedro Guevara Memorial High School
title.orig: An Act to Change the Name of the Laguna High School in Sta. Cruz, Province of Laguna, to Pedro Guevara Memorial High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Trung học Laguna tại Tỉnh Laguna thành Trường Trung học Tưởng niệm Pedro Guevara
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Laguna ในจังหวัด Laguna เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอนุสรณ์ Pedro Guevara
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Menengah Laguna di Provinsi Laguna menjadi Sekolah Menengah Memorial Pedro Guevara
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Menengah Laguna di Wilayah Laguna kepada Sekolah Menengah Memorial Pedro Guevara

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_985_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In recognition of the eminent and patriotic services rendered to the country by the late Pedro Guevara, in the name of Laguna High School in Sta. Cruz, Province of Laguna, is hereby changed to Pedro Guevara Memorial High School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 2, 1954.
